quarterly_data.signal: The company said on SSE e-Interactive: in H1 2026 its training software platform made staged progress in large-model training adaptation, training efficiency and system stability, with work on training ecosystem, model adaptation and performance optimisation, low-precision training and training tools; its inference software platform (large-model inference, computation-graph compilation, operator programming and acceleration libraries, communication) improved in function, model adaptation, efficiency and stability and achieved staged results in internal R&D, customer business and search / recommendation scenarios.

Asked whether it had privately told institutional investors of a rumoured next-year chip shipment expectation circulating in the market, the company said on SSE e-Interactive that it has never made any such communication, and that it will disclose any material matter required by law through its announcements.
